5. Unemployment
In common parlance anybody who is not gainfully employed in any
productive activity is called unemployed. However; it can be of two
kinds (i) voluntary unemployed and (ii) involuntary unemployed. Here
we are concerned with the second category of unemployed persons
Hence, unemployment can be defined as a situation when persons able
and willing to work are seeking jobs at the prevailing wage level but
they are unable to get the same_
Unemployment in developing economies like India is not the result of

In India unemployment is structural in nature due to lack ofproductive
